verdict: Organic presence is softening across all three locations; blockers need resolution.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, your Google Business Profile listings were the only active source of inbound engagement this period — no paid campaigns ran on any channel. Combined, the three entities generated 382 total profile actions (calls, direction requests, and web clicks) in the last 28 days, but all three locations showed declining engagement in the most recent 7 days, with drops ranging from 30% to 67%. The slide is tied to reduced local search visibility, and a web and SEO root-cause fix already in motion is the primary lever to reverse it. Several overdue setup milestones — including contact list pulls needed to launch outreach sequences — are being resolved now, and the email and calling pipeline will be ready to deploy once those are cleared by end of September.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations this period
steepest single-location GBP engagement drop week over week (Advance Grinding Services)
calls recorded this period across two O'Hare profiles despite hundreds of impressions — call tracking is being investigated

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining across all three locations while organic search is the only active channel, and two O'Hare profiles recorded zero calls despite active impressions — a likely tracking issue.
watch_item.fix: The web and SEO root-cause fix is in progress, the two affected profiles are being audited for call button and tracking errors, and the outreach contact list is being finalized to open a second lead channel before end of month.
